problem_statement: The Dashmin Bootstrap admin template is a static multi-page dashboard (Dashboard, Widgets, Forms, Tables, Charts, plus a separate Sign In page) with a fixed sidebar, sticky navbar, KPI cards, widgets, forms, tables, and Chart.js charts. An 'Operations pulse board' summary strip is meant to sit right after the navbar on ALL FIVE primary admin pages (Dashboard, Widgets, Forms, Tables, Charts). It carries four metric tiles (Open tickets, Response SLA, Active users, Records synced), a route-specific 'Current view' context line, and an interactive Support/Traffic scope switcher whose readout must update when a scope pill is clicked. In the shipped state the board has three coupled defects: (1) it was laid out as a single fixed-width, non-wrapping flex row, so on a 390px mobile viewport it pushes the whole admin page past the viewport and the dashboard scrolls horizontally (~420px of overflow) while desktop/tablet look fine; (2) it was only mounted on the Dashboard page, so Widgets/Forms/Tables/Charts silently miss the shared board; and (3) the scope switcher moves the active pill but never re-syncs the readout. Repair the board so it is present and consistent on all five admin pages, the mobile pages have no horizontal overflow, and clicking the Traffic scope pill updates the readout to 'Showing: Traffic metrics' — while preserving every page's existing sidebar, navbar dropdown behavior, KPI cards, widgets, forms, tables, charts, the Sign In page, the local assets, and the static architecture exactly as they are.
required_content: Fix the layout so the 390px mobile admin pages (mobile_initial, mobile_dashboard, mobile_dashboard_sidebar) have no horizontal overflow: the document scroll width must not exceed the viewport beyond a small tolerance.

Mount the Operations pulse board consistently on ALL FIVE admin pages (index.html, widget.html, form.html, table.html, chart.html) with its route-specific 'Current view' context: Dashboard / Analytics, Widgets, Forms, Tables, and Charts respectively.
Keep every pulse board tile visible and readable: Open tickets, Response SLA, Active users, and Records synced, plus the 'Dashmin operations pulse board' heading and 'OPERATIONS PULSE' eyebrow.

Wire the Support/Traffic scope switcher so that clicking the Traffic pill updates the '#pulseReadout' readout to 'Showing: Traffic metrics' (and moves the active pill); the terminal readout must reflect the selected scope, not stay stale.
Keep the board's Dashmin visual language intact: bg-light card, primary-blue accent, white tiles, muted uppercase labels; do not recolor it to an off-palette treatment.
Preserve original Dashboard, Widgets, Basic Form, Basic Table, Single Line Chart, Sign In, DASHMIN, Jhon Doe, Today Sale, Messages, Sales & Revenue, and Worldwide Sales content.
Preserve original sidebar active states, navbar dropdown behavior, and the sidebar toggler on mobile.

Preserve local assets and static architecture including css/bootstrap.min.css, css/style.css, css/pulseboard.css, js/main.js, js/pulseboard.js, img/user.jpg; do not add a framework, build step, router, dependency, or remote asset.

Repair the styling in the pulse board's own stylesheet (css/pulseboard.css) and its interaction script (js/pulseboard.js), not by removing the board, deleting cards/tables/charts, or masking overflow with a document-level clip.
design_constraints: Keep the static Bootstrap admin architecture and the existing Dashmin visual language: bg-light cards, rounded corners, var(--primary) accent, Bootstrap spacing, compact h6 headings, muted uppercase labels, and the current sidebar/navbar layout.

The fix is a cross-page responsive + interaction repair of the pulse board strip after the navbar, not a replacement for KPI cards, widgets, forms, tables, or charts, and not a new route, modal, or detached app.
Do not alter the sign-in page except preserving it as a regression state; do not change navigation links, dropdowns, chart scripts, table markup, or form markup while fixing the board.
Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile states must have no horizontal overflow after the repair, and the board must remain visually intact (on-palette) on desktop and mobile.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial verify canonical dashboard rendering of the pulse board across primary viewports; the reference wraps the board on mobile so there is no horizontal overflow while the unrepaired baseline overflows.
desktop_dashboard and mobile_dashboard scroll to the Operations pulse board and verify it renders as a clean, on-palette multi-tile strip.
desktop_widgets, desktop_forms, desktop_tables, desktop_charts verify the shared pulse board is present with the correct 'Current view' route context on every admin page (cross-page consistency).

desktop_pulse_traffic clicks the Traffic scope pill and verifies the readout terminal state becomes 'Showing: Traffic metrics' (the interaction actually updates the readout, not just the active pill).
desktop_notifications_open opens a navbar dropdown and verifies dropdown behavior survives the repair.
mobile_dashboard_sidebar toggles the sidebar and verifies the toggler and pulse board remain usable at 390px with no horizontal overflow after the repair.
mobile_forms verifies the form page stacks without horizontal overflow on mobile.
desktop_signin verifies the standalone Sign In page remains unchanged enough to preserve DASHMIN and Sign In content.

change_completion: The 390px mobile admin pages have no horizontal overflow after the repair.
The Operations pulse board is present and consistent on all five admin pages, and the Traffic scope pill updates the readout terminal state.
design_consistency: The repaired board keeps the Dashmin / Bootstrap visual language: bg-light cards, primary accent, white tiles, muted uppercase labels.
The fix extends the board's own stylesheet + interaction script rather than removing the board, editing unrelated files, hiding overflow at the document level, or recoloring off-palette.
regression: Original sidebar active states, navbar dropdown behavior, dashboard, widgets, forms, tables, charts, and sign-in page content remain present and usable.
No new framework, route system, dependency, or remote asset is introduced; KPI cards, charts, tables, forms, and navigation links are unchanged.
responsive: Desktop, tablet, and mobile states have no horizontal overflow after the repair.
The pulse board tiles remain readable and fully visible on 390px mobile.
evaluation_rubric.scoring_notes: A correct patch is a cross-page responsive + interaction repair of the pulse board. Patches that merely clip overflow (overflow-x:hidden while keeping a fixed-width nowrap row), mount the board on one page only, recolor it off-palette, or move the active pill without updating the readout should fail the no-overflow, cross-page dom, visual_regression, or interaction checks.
